sources: DataSF 311 Cases (vw6y-z8j6): service_name values and volumes, past year
sf.gov 311 service pages (one source_url per entry)
meta.disclaimer: Unofficial and not a City of San Francisco tool. The official SF311 app, sf.gov forms, and the 311 phone line are the source of truth.
meta.curation_rule: Only facts stated on the linked page. Fields the page does not state are null. Partner agencies are listed as the page lists them; no single owning department is claimed unless the page says so.
meta.how_to_report: SF311 mobile app (Android/iOS), the sf.gov form linked in source_url, or call 311 (415-701-2311 from outside San Francisco; TDD/TTY 711).

service_types.title: Request street or sidewalk cleaning
have_ready: Type of object (e.g. loose trash, furniture, mattress, shopping cart)
notes: To report the act of dumping itself, there is a separate 'Report illegal dumping activity' form; then request cleaning for the items.

not_this_if.if: an overflowing or damaged public garbage can, or a residential bin left out
your own household bulky items you want picked up
not_this_if.use_text: Schedule a Recology Bulky Item Recycling pickup (per the sf.gov page).

service_types.title: Report garbage container issues
have_ready: What is wrong with the container (overflowing, spilling, damaged, left out after collection)

not_this_if.if: street cleaning did not happen on schedule
loose trash or dumped items on the street (not in a container)

service_types.title: Report graffiti issues
have_ready: The object the graffiti is on
Whether it contains racial slurs or profanity

not_this_if.if: graffiti on a parking or traffic sign
stickers, posters or flyers rather than paint
it is on State or Federal property (e.g. a USPS mailbox, freeway structure)

service_types.title: Report blocked driveway or illegal parking
have_ready: Nature of the problem (e.g. blocked driveway, double parking)
notes: If you want the vehicle towed, you must meet the officer.
To cancel after the vehicle moves, call 415-695-7200, option 5.

not_this_if.if: a vehicle parked in one spot more than 72 hours and not blocking a driveway

service_types.title: Report an abandoned vehicle
have_ready: How long it has been there (must be more than 72 hours)

not_this_if.if: the vehicle is blocking a driveway

service_types.title: Report pothole and street issues
have_ready: Exact location (street address and nearest cross street)

not_this_if.if: the problem is on a sidewalk, curb, curb ramp, or public stairway
it is on a freeway or freeway ramp

service_types.title: Report curb and sidewalk problems
have_ready: Exact location, with a description of where on the block

not_this_if.if: something is blocking the sidewalk rather than the sidewalk being damaged
the damage is in the street (pothole, pavement)

service_types.title: Report a problem with a streetlight
have_ready: Type of pole if you can tell (concrete, metal, wooden, or unknown)

not_this_if.if: it is a traffic signal or pedestrian signal, not a streetlight

emergency_notes: Downed or sparking power lines are an emergency: call 911.

service_types.title: Report a damaged or fallen tree
have_ready: Nature of the problem (e.g. fallen, hanging limb, blocking sidewalk or street)
notes: Issues that are not an immediate safety concern, like routine pruning of overgrown trees, are deferred until StreetTreeSF reaches the neighborhood.
emergency_notes: Call 911 if the problem involves power lines, vehicles, or buildings.

service_types.title: Report flooding, water leaks, sewer backup, or odor issues
have_ready: Type of issue (e.g. water pooling in the street, strong sewage odor)
emergency_notes: If a fire hydrant is damaged, gushing water, or leaking a lot, call 911 immediately.

service_types.title: Report homeless encampments
have_ready: Description of the tents or structures (describe conditions, not people)
Photo taken from a safe distance
service_types.contact: Name and phone number listed as needed
notes: For concerns about an unhoused person who is not in an encampment, sf.gov has a separate request for service.

not_this_if.if: a person or tent is blocking an entrance or the sidewalk

emergency_notes: If someone needs medical help right away, or is hurting themselves or others, call 911.

service_types.title: Report a noise problem
have_ready: Description of the noise (when it happens, how long)
notes: Persistent noise from a neighbor or business: sf.gov suggests Community Boards (communityboards.org).
Noise in an apartment building may be the landlord's responsibility; sf.gov points to the Rent Board.

not_this_if.if: noise is happening right now and violates the noise ordinance

service_types.title: Report a blocked pedestrian walkway or sidewalk
have_ready: The object blocking the walkway (e.g. construction equipment, news rack, shrub)

not_this_if.if: a person is blocking an entrance or leaving less than 6 ft of sidewalk clearance (sf.gov says do not submit a report)
a Bay Wheels bikeshare bike is parked badly or blocking
restaurant or bar outdoor seating is blocking

service_types.title: Report damaged public property
have_ready: Type of object (bench, bike rack, callbox, kiosk, public toilet, news rack, parking meter, safe-hit post, transit shelter)
Object ID number if there is one
service_types.photo: suggested (of the damage and where it is)

not_this_if.if: a broken traffic signal
a damaged parking or traffic sign
graffiti on the object (not physical damage)

other_311_forms.title: Report a missed street cleaning route
Report an issue with a parking or traffic sign
Report a broken or malfunctioning traffic signal (sf.gov says call 311 for quicker response)
Report a violation of sidewalk or parking lane use by businesses
Submit a parks related request (problems inside a park, playground, or rec facility)
Report a residential building concern (living conditions, SROs)

not_311.situation: A person blocking an entrance or the sidewalk, or ongoing noise that violates the noise ordinance (not life-threatening)
Litter, debris, potholes, graffiti or other issues on a state freeway or freeway ramp (e.g. US-101, I-80, I-280)
not_311.go_to: Caltrans Customer Service Request at csr.dot.ca.gov (non-urgent issues)

not_311.situation: Graffiti or problems on State or Federal property (for example a USPS mailbox)
not_311.go_to: Contact the owning State or Federal agency directly. If you file with 311 anyway, the City will try to forward it and then close the request.

not_311.situation: The problem is outside the City and County of San Francisco (e.g. Oakland, Daly City)
not_311.go_to: That city's own public works or 311 service. SF311 cannot act there.

emergency_signs: someone unresponsive, not breathing, seriously injured, or needing medical help right away
someone hurting themselves or others, or a crime in progress
downed or sparking power lines, or a tree on power lines, vehicles, or buildings
a fire hydrant damaged, gushing, or leaking a lot
